goal: Decide whether a consensus round commits, so a validator's step can be checked against the quorum rule.

app.name: bft-commit
app.title: Quorum commit
app.purpose: Decide whether a round commits, waits, or moves to the next round, from the precommits seen, the quorum the validator set requires and whether the round timed out.

fields.name: precommits
fields.means: precommit votes seen, by voting power

fields.name: quorum
fields.means: voting power a commit needs, more than two thirds

fields.name: timeout
fields.means: whether the round's precommit timeout fired

rules.why: a quorum of precommits commits the block
without a quorum a timeout moves to the next round

app.otherwiseWhy: no quorum yet and time remains

properties.why: safety: no commit without a quorum

stakeholders.name: Validator
stakeholders.text: Runs a validator and needs a block committed only on a quorum, and always on one.
